title: De novo design of high-potency dual-target therapeutic peptides with ORIDTP
description:
Nature, Published online: 25 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s41586-026-11338-1

The artificial intelligence platform ORIDTP enabled de novo design of potent dual-target therapeutic peptides, generating candidate anti-obesity, antidiabetic and anticancer peptides with strong in vivo efficacy and broad cross-target generalizability.
